---
title: Changelog

## [1.4.0] - 2026-11-20

### Added
- Add {@link @imfusion/sdk!OverlayType | SliceScrollBar} for navigating image slices through {@link @imfusion/sdk!RadiologyViewOverlays.addOverlay | RadiologyViewOverlays.addOverlay()}.
- Add Point annotations to the supported {@link @imfusion/sdk!AnnotationType | annotation types}.
- Add non-interactive annotation creation through {@link @imfusion/sdk!AnnotationModel.add | AnnotationModel.add(type, data, state, frameIndex?)}.
- Add optional frame attachment to annotations.
- Add clickable annotation triggers in slice and volume views (see {@link @imfusion/sdk!Annotation.setTrigger | Annotation.setTrigger()}).
- Add {@link @imfusion/sdk!Annotation.onChanged | Annotation.onChanged()} for listening to changes to an individual annotation.
- Add {@link @imfusion/sdk!Annotation.navigationPoint | Annotation.navigationPoint()}.
- Add {@link @imfusion/sdk!RadiologyViewGroup.centerOnLocation | RadiologyViewGroup.centerOnLocation()} for navigating views to point in world coordinates.
- Forward keyboard events to display, and add {@link @imfusion/sdk!Display.handleKeyDown | Display.handleKeyDown()} and {@link @imfusion/sdk!Display.handleKeyUp | Display.handleKeyUp()}.
- Add {@link @imfusion/sdk!SliceIndicator.setRenderMode2d | SliceIndicator.setRenderMode2d()} and {@link @imfusion/sdk!SliceIndicator.setRenderMode3d | SliceIndicator.setRenderMode3d()} to configure what the slice indicators render.
- Add {@link @imfusion/sdk!Brush.undoRedoStack | Brush.undoRedoStack} to provide {@link @imfusion/sdk!BrushUndoRedo.undo | undo}/{@link @imfusion/sdk!BrushUndoRedo.redo | redo} functionality for the Brush.
- Add {@link @imfusion/sdk!DisplayAutoLayouter.animationsEnabled | DisplayAutoLayouter.animationsEnabled} and the {@link @imfusion/sdk!InitOptions.layoutAnimations | layoutAnimations} init option to control layout animations separately from other UI animations.

### Fixed
- Fix Mesh contour rendering in volume view.
- Fix configuration state returning strings instead of numbers for lists of vectors, matrices, and colors.
- Fix annotations staying when their parent dataset is removed.
- Fix {@link @imfusion/sdk!SliceIndicator.visible | SliceIndicator.visible} resetting the slice indicator rendering settings when toggled.
- Fix {@link @imfusion/sdk!Bindings.save | save()} keeping only the focused frame of image sets with 3D frames.

### Changed
- Render volumes with global illumination ({@link @imfusion/sdk!RenderMode | GlobalIllumDVR}) by default. To restore the previous behavior: `display.main3dView().renderMode = 'PhongDVR'`.
- Show slice indicators with rotation handles at their ends by default. To restore the previous behavior: `display.sliceIndicator().setRenderMode2d(['Line', 'Thickness'])`.
- Deprecate `Mesh.vertex()`, `Mesh.setVertex()`, and `Mesh.faceVertices()` in favor of {@link @imfusion/sdk!Mesh.vertexPosition | vertexPosition()}, {@link @imfusion/sdk!Mesh.setVertexPosition | setVertexPosition()}, and {@link @imfusion/sdk!Mesh.faceVertexIndices | faceVertexIndices()}.
- Deprecate two-argument `AnnotationModel.add(type, data)` in favor of {@link @imfusion/sdk!AnnotationModel.addInteractive | addInteractive(type, data)}.
- Disable layout animations (e.g. when maximizing a view or changing the layout mode) by default. To restore the previous behavior: `init(canvas, { layoutAnimations: true })` or `display.layouter().animationsEnabled = true`.


## [1.3.1] - 2026-11-05

### Added
- Add more bindings for controlling the {@link @imfusion/sdk!Brush | Brush} state via properties.
- Add {@link @imfusion/sdk!Brush#onBrushSettingsChanged | onBrushSettingsChanged} and its React counterpart {@link @imfusion/sdk-react!useBrush} to listen for changes to the Brush state.

### Changed
- Deprecated  {@link @imfusion/sdk!Brush#setRadiusMM | Brush.setRadiusMM}, {@link @imfusion/sdk!Brush#setAdaptiveness | Brush.setAdaptiveness}, and {@link @imfusion/sdk!Brush#setFilter | Brush.setFilter} in favor of corresponding properties.
- **Breaking:** Rename the `EmbindModule` type to {@link @imfusion/sdk!Bindings | Bindings} and `EmbindString` to {@link @imfusion/sdk!StringOrBytes | StringOrBytes}. {@link @imfusion/sdk!ImFusion.bindings | ImFusion.bindings} is now typed as `Bindings`, which no longer includes Emscripten runtime members such as `FS`. Use {@link @imfusion/sdk!ImFusion.FS | ImFusion.FS} instead.
- Set the {@link @imfusion/sdk!OverlayType | ViewOrderButton} overlay visibility to false by default.

## [1.3.0] - 2026-10-23

### Added
- Add {@link @imfusion/sdk!Bindings.onLabelConfigChanged | onLabelConfigChanged} and its React counterpart {@link @imfusion/sdk-react!useLabelConfig} to listen for label configuration changes.
- Add {@link @imfusion/sdk!SliceView.defaultEventHandler | SliceView.defaultEventHandler} which can be used to configure view interactions.
- Add {@link @imfusion/sdk!Display.sliceIndicator | Display.sliceIndicator} to allow controlling the visibility of the slice indicators.

### Changed
- **Breaking:** Change the return and parameter types of {@link @imfusion/sdk!Bindings.getLabelConfigs | getLabelConfigs} and {@link @imfusion/sdk!Bindings.setLabelConfigs | setLabelConfigs} to a native TypeScript `Map<number, LabelConfig>`.
- Update default view styling with sharp borders.

## [1.2.1] - 2026-09-28

### Added
- Add {@link @imfusion/sdk!View.borderConfig} for configuring the rendering of a View's border

## [1.2.0] - 2026-09-27

### Added
- Introduce {@link @imfusion/sdk!SliceView | SliceView} for 2D MPR views
- Add support for controlling various view settings:  {@link @imfusion/sdk!SliceView.blendingMode | SliceView.blendingMode}, {@link @imfusion/sdk!SliceView.blendingFactor | SliceView.blendingFactor}, and {@link @imfusion/sdk!SliceView.interpolationMode | SliceView.interpolationMode}.
- Add {@link @imfusion/sdk!DisplayOptions2d.transferFunctionPresetNames | DisplayOptions2d.transferFunctionPresetNames()} and
  {@link @imfusion/sdk!DisplayOptions2d.applyTransferFunctionPreset | DisplayOptions2d.applyTransferFunctionPreset()}, with equivalent methods on {@link @imfusion/sdk!DisplayOptions3d | DisplayOptions3d}, for listing and applying transfer-function presets.
- Add support for creating, loading, editing, and displaying {@link @imfusion/sdk!Graph | Graphs}.
- Add support for creating, and modifying {@link @imfusion/sdk!Mesh} instances.
- Add {@link @imfusion/sdk!Mesh.onChanged | Mesh.onChanged} for listening for Mesh changes.
- Add {@link @imfusion/sdk!SharedImageSet.imageInfo | SharedImageSet.imageInfo} for querying DICOM information from images.
- Add support for querying and setting the matrix/matrices of {@link @imfusion/sdk!Data | Data} instances. See for example {@link @imfusion/sdk!Image.matrixFromWorld | Image.matrixFromWorld} or {@link @imfusion/sdk!Image.matrixToWorld | Image.matrixToWorld}
- Add an optional {@link @imfusion/sdk!FileFormat | FileFormat} argument to {@link @imfusion/sdk!ImFusion.loadFile | ImFusion.loadFile},
  {@link @imfusion/sdk!ImFusion.loadFileFromUrl | ImFusion.loadFileFromUrl}, {@link @imfusion/sdk!ImFusion.loadBuffer | ImFusion.loadBuffer},
  and {@link @imfusion/sdk!DataModel.loadFile | DataModel.loadFile}. These functions now attempt to detect a file format automatically based on content when no format is given and the filename has no recognized extension.
- {@link @imfusion/sdk!ImFusion.loadFileFromUrl | ImFusion.loadFileFromUrl} now takes the filename from the `filename*` or `filename` parameter of the
  [Content-Disposition](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTTP/Reference/Headers/Content-Disposition) header if present.
- Add support for controlling {@link @imfusion/sdk!RadiologyViewOverlays.setOverlayVisibility | ViewOverlay visibility}, the type of the {@link @imfusion/sdk!RadiologyViewOverlays.setOrientationMeshType | OrientationMeshOverlay} and the display of the {@link @imfusion/sdk!RadiologyViewOverlays.setPatientInfoFormatter | PatientInfoOverlay}.
- Add support for rendering mesh contours in the Volume View.

### Fixed
- Preserve dataset-provided 2D windowing when loading images.

### Changed
- **Breaking:** Replace `DisplayOptions2d.transferFunction` and `DisplayOptions3d.transferFunction` properties with
  {@link @imfusion/sdk!DisplayOptions2d.transferFunction | DisplayOptions2d.transferFunction()} and
  {@link @imfusion/sdk!DisplayOptions3d.transferFunction | DisplayOptions3d.transferFunction()}, which return borrowed
  {@link @imfusion/sdk!TransferFunction | TransferFunction} handles. TransferFunction now supports both keypoint and LUT modes and provides {@link @imfusion/sdk!TransferFunction.tissues | tissues()}, {@link @imfusion/sdk!TransferFunction.lut | lut()},
  {@link @imfusion/sdk!TransferFunction.setTissues | setTissues()}, and {@link @imfusion/sdk!TransferFunction.setLut | setLut()} for accessing and updating either representation.
- **Breaking:** Remove `TransferFunctionFactory`. Use
  {@link @imfusion/sdk!DisplayOptions2d.transferFunctionPresetNames | DisplayOptions2d.transferFunctionPresetNames()} and
  {@link @imfusion/sdk!DisplayOptions2d.applyTransferFunctionPreset | DisplayOptions2d.applyTransferFunctionPreset()}, or the
  corresponding {@link @imfusion/sdk!DisplayOptions3d | DisplayOptions3d} methods, instead.

- Add {@link @imfusion/sdk!InitOptions.licenseToken | InitOptions.licenseToken}.

## [1.0.0] - 2026-06-30

### Added

- Add a high-level TypeScript wrapper (see Getting Started guide).
- Add support for loading, displaying, and saving meshes.
- Add bindings for {@link @imfusion/sdk!ImageDescriptor | ImageDescriptor} and {@link @imfusion/sdk!ImageDescriptorWorld | ImageDescriptorWorld}.
- Add {@link @imfusion/sdk!DataModel.getImage | DataModel.getImage} and {@link @imfusion/sdk!DataModel.getImages | DataModel.getImages} for retrieving {@link @imfusion/sdk!SharedImageSet | SharedImageSets} from the {@link @imfusion/sdk!DataModel | DataModel}.
- Add {@link @imfusion/sdk!DataModel.find | DataModel.find} to look up a dataset by name.
- Add {@link @imfusion/sdk!DataModel.clear | DataModel.clear}.
- Add {@link @imfusion/sdk!DataModel.data | DataModel.data}.
- Add {@link @imfusion/sdk!ImFusion.destroy | ImFusion.destroy} to release browser-side resources.
- Add type-safe listener methods for event subscriptions:
  - {@link @imfusion/sdk!DataModel.onDataAdded | DataModel.onDataAdded}, {@link @imfusion/sdk!DataModel.onDataAboutToBeRemoved | DataModel.onDataAboutToBeRemoved}
  - {@link @imfusion/sdk!SharedImageSet.onSelectionChanged | SharedImageSet.onSelectionChanged}
  - {@link @imfusion/sdk!View.onVisibleDataChanged | View.onVisibleDataChanged}
  - {@link @imfusion/sdk!DisplayOptions2d.onChanged | DisplayOptions2d.onChanged}, {@link @imfusion/sdk!DisplayOptions3d.onChanged | DisplayOptions3d.onChanged}
  - {@link @imfusion/sdk!DisplayAutoLayouter.onModeChanged | DisplayAutoLayouter.onModeChanged}, {@link @imfusion/sdk!DisplayAutoLayouter.onViewHiddenChanged | DisplayAutoLayouter.onViewHiddenChanged}
  - {@link @imfusion/sdk!RadiologyViewGroup.onVisibleDataChanged | RadiologyViewGroup.onVisibleDataChanged}
  - {@link @imfusion/sdk!Display.onUpdateRequested | Display.onUpdateRequested}
  - {@link @imfusion/sdk!AnnotationModel.onAnnotationAdded | AnnotationModel.onAnnotationAdded}, {@link @imfusion/sdk!AnnotationModel.onAnnotationAboutToBeRemoved | AnnotationModel.onAnnotationAboutToBeRemoved}, {@link @imfusion/sdk!AnnotationModel.onAnnotationEvent | AnnotationModel.onAnnotationEvent}
- Add support for [Custom Rendering](/custom-rendering).
- Add `@imfusion/sdk-react` package with react bindings for the SDK.
- Add {@link @imfusion/sdk!preloadWasm | preloadWasm} to allow running wasm compilation in parallel to other startup actions.
- Add {@link @imfusion/sdk!prefetch | prefetch} and {@link @imfusion/sdk!clearPrefetch | clearPrefetch}.
- Add {@link @imfusion/sdk!ImFusion.loadFolderFromUrls | loadFolderFromUrls} to fetch and load a folder.
- Add support for running {@link @imfusion/sdk!Algorithm | Algorithms}.

### Fixed

- Fix enum runtime representation in release builds.
- Fix `display.onUpdateRequested` not firing when visible data changed.

### Changed

- **Breaking:** Change `init()` signature: The canvas element is now a separate first argument instead of a property in the options object.
  ```typescript
  // Before
  const imf = await init({ canvas: myCanvas, autoResize: true });
  // After
  const imf = await init(myCanvas, { autoResize: true });
  ```
- **Breaking:** Move raw bindings to `@imfusion/sdk/bindings`.
  ```typescript
  // Before
  import LoadImFusionLib from '@imfusion/sdk'
  // After
  import LoadImFusionLib from '@imfusion/sdk/bindings'
  ```
- **Breaking:** Remove the `Handle` postfix from type names. Type aliases preserve backwards compatibility for type names and methods, but constructors must be updated (e.g., use `new sdk.SharedImageSet()` instead of `new sdk.SharedImageSetHandle()`).
- **Breaking:** Move {@link @imfusion/sdk!SharedImageSet.minmaxIntensityOriginal | SharedImageSet.minmaxIntensityOriginal}, {@link @imfusion/sdk!SharedImageSet.histogram | SharedImageSet.histogram}, {@link @imfusion/sdk!SharedImageSet.autoWindow | SharedImageSet.autoWindow}, {@link @imfusion/sdk!SharedImageSet.displayOptions2d | SharedImageSet.displayOptions2d}, and {@link @imfusion/sdk!SharedImageSet.displayOptions3d | SharedImageSet.displayOptions3d} from `Data` to {@link @imfusion/sdk!SharedImageSet | SharedImageSet}. Use {@link @imfusion/sdk!DataModel.getImage | DataModel.getImage} to retrieve a {@link @imfusion/sdk!SharedImageSet | SharedImageSet}, then call the method.
- **Breaking:** Redesign {@link @imfusion/sdk!DataModel | DataModel} as an iterable collection.
  - {@link @imfusion/sdk!DataModel | DataModel} is iterable (`for...of`, spread).
  - {@link @imfusion/sdk!DataModel.get | DataModel.get} now takes an index instead of a name. Use {@link @imfusion/sdk!DataModel.find | DataModel.find} for name lookup.
  - {@link @imfusion/sdk!DataModel.add | DataModel.add} returns `boolean`.
  - {@link @imfusion/sdk!DataModel.remove | DataModel.remove} returns `boolean`.
- **Breaking:** Remove `DataList` and `AnnotationList` from the API. All functions that previously accepted or returned these types now use `Data[]` / {@link @imfusion/sdk!HandleArray | HandleArray}&lt;{@link @imfusion/sdk!Data | Data}&gt; and {@link @imfusion/sdk!HandleArray | HandleArray}&lt;{@link @imfusion/sdk!Annotation | Annotation}&gt; instead. See [Object Ownership and Aliasing](/ownership).
- Rename {@link @imfusion/sdk!Display | Display} input handlers from `on...()` to `handle...()` (e.g., `onMouseDown()` → {@link @imfusion/sdk!Display.handleMouseDown | Display.handleMouseDown}); old names are deprecated.
- Change `state()` return type from `Object` to `Record<string, unknown>`.
- Deprecate the global event system (`addEventListener`, `removeEventListener`, `EventType`, `EventListener`, `Event`) in favor of the new listener methods.
- **Breaking:** Change return type of {@link @imfusion/sdk!DataModel.getImages | DataModel.getImages} and {@link @imfusion/sdk!Bindings.getImages | getImages} to {@link @imfusion/sdk!HandleArray | HandleArray}

---

## [0.7.0] - 2025-12-03

### Added

- Add {@link @imfusion/sdk!Brush.radiusRangeMM | Brush.radiusRangeMM} to compute a reasonable brush radius range based on the input image.
- Add animation support.
- Add a global illumination volume renderer.
- Add parameter names and docstrings to the generated TypeScript definitions.
- Add TypeDoc-based documentation.

### Fixed

- Fix missing render calls in context menu actions.

### Changed

- **Breaking:** Change enum representations to string literal unions. Remove `.value` from enum comparisons.
  ```typescript
  // Before
  mode.value === 'Auto'
  // After
  mode === 'Auto'
  ```
